explanation: Merged main (#30, #31, #32, #34) into the bundle-reader branch. From this branch: bundleReader.test.ts pins the writer-to-reader round trip, strict JSONP parsing and registry unit precedence; bundleReaderParity.test.ts pins Node reader labels to loadDatasetMeta for every committed meta.js; agentExport.test.ts reads published bytes through readJsonp and asserts the reviewed GSE174085 label. From main: hypomapCodetection/hypomapCoexpression/hypomapMetrics tests cover the co-detection client against its wire golden, expressionSurvey and expressionSurveyLoad tests cover survey derivation and per-source retry, and sourceJson tests cover the shared expression-source reader.
